notes_for_editor: Thin record. Two listings and a history page with no narrative: no exact build year, builder, design, staffing, fire, or removal date in any source read. The register's 1930s is kept only in the story and evidence, because an event needs a year. The brief's kind 'unknown' is not resolved. Worth checking Ochoco National Forest archives or a Crook County historical society before expanding.
